messages:
arjun: Heads-up — we just noticed a big drop in decision-log coverage for the /v1/generate route after the sampling rate change this morning. only ~4% of requests have decision traces now.
maya: ugh, was that the global sampling toggle flip at 09:10? I set it to 5% to cut storage.
arjun: yeah that one. but the odd part: traffic from dedicated customers still has traces, hosted not. looks like header-based override is not honoring the sampling rule.
lucy: can you paste an example of a request header where override should apply?
arjun: sure. example:

```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
X-Redwood-Customer: cust-123
X-Decision-Log-Force: true
Content-Type: application/json
```

we expect X-Decision-Log-Force to force full logging
sre-jen: quick check — is the override evaluated before sampling or after? config says override should bypass sampling but might be in diff execution path.
maya: override is implemented in route evaluator's pre-filter step. but there was a refactor last week that moved sampling to an earlier stage for perf.
arjun: exact suspicion. I grabbed a few sampled traces and they show `sampling_decision: skip` even when `override_header: true` present.
opsbot: deploy-bot noticed a small deploy to router-service at 1779451200 with change-set "perf: early-sampling".
lucy: that matches. probable bug: pre-filter/includes headers are not accessible at the early sampling hook because we don't parse full headers until route match.
maya: quick mitigation: we can add a lightweight header check into the early sampling hook (just lookup raw header map) and respect X-Decision-Log-Force. cheap change.
arjun: fine by me. can someone draft the patch? we should also add an e2e test to cover header-override + sampling.
sre-jen: I'll prep a hotfix branch and a canary rollout. suggestion: enable full decision logs for 30m while the fix lands so we don't miss incidents.
lucy: +1 — also add a dashboard card in Console under Telemetry -> Decision Log Coverage showing sampling rate + override hits.
opsbot: created issue INF-5123 "fix early-sampling header-override" and attached sample traces.
devops-bot: canary rollout started: router-service:v2.3.4-hotfix to 5% of traffic in us-west at 1779460200.
maya: after deploy, I ran a quick curl with the header and got a trace id back in the response, looks good:

```
curl -s -H "X-Decision-Log-Force: true" -H "Authorization: Bearer x" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq .trace_id
"trace_20260318_0001"
```

arjun: nice. keep an eye for any perf regressions from the extra header check.
sre-jen: monitoring added: alert if p50 latency increases > 20ms on router-service for 5m post-rollout.
lucy: long term, we should document sampling evaluation order in the routing policy docs and add a unit for "early hooks vs route filters".
maya: Agreed. I'll follow up with a docs PR and a small console banner explaining why customers might see missing traces during sampling rollouts.
arjun: thanks team. follow-ups: INF-5123 assigned to sre-jen, docs PR from maya, dashboard card from lucy. I'll leave the temporary 30m full-logging window enabled until we confirm no gaps. :thumbsup:
